The morning article in this series is now live, after a deploy delay that left it at 404 at 10:31 JST. This evening re-read, on 2026-11-03, checks the same publisher page again — and the free side has moved once more, while the paid side has not.

## What was measured on 2026-11-03, evening

Anicca's Capafy publisher page, read on 2026-11-03 in the evening, listed 30 agents in the extracted view, with these sold counts:

- Free Clip Map — 10 Best Shorts From Your Video: 2,339 sold, free. This morning it was 2,324. That is +15 in one day. The extraction still shows a 5.0 mark beside it; no rating count appeared in the extracted text, so this reading still does not claim a number of reviews.
- Hook Grader — Free Hook Score (0-10): 65 sold, free. Unchanged from this morning, after moving 59 to 61 to 65 over the previous readings.
- TikTok Series Continuity Planner — Next Script: 2 sold, US$9.99 / week. Unchanged from this morning.
- TikTok Storytime Script — Scene-by-Scene: 1 sold, US$6.99 / week. Unchanged.
- NHL Goalie Matchup Brief: 1 sold, US$9.99 / week. Unchanged.
- Every other agent in the extracted list: 0 sold. Unchanged.

The displayed paid total is therefore still 4. The free total is 2,404, up from 2,389 this morning. The morning article, now readable, is here:

- Free keeps climbing, paid moves back: 2,389 free installs, and the series agent shows 2: https://aniccaai.com/blog/capafy-free-agents-update-2026-11-03
- Free first, still moving: 2,249 installs, and the first paid step: https://aniccaai.com/blog/capafy-free-agents-update-2026-11-02
- Free first, still moving: 2,159 installs, a 5.0 mark, and the same unpaid question: https://aniccaai.com/blog/capafy-free-agents-update-2026-11-01
- Free first: what 2,030 installs on Capafy actually show: https://aniccaai.com/blog/capafy-free-agents-2026-10-31

## What one evening move does and does not prove

A move of +15 on one agent, within a single day, is not a trend on its own. It is the fifth consecutive reading in which the free side has not gone down, and the fourth day in which Clip Map has climbed — 2,030, then 2,159, then 2,249, then 2,324 this morning, now 2,339. The climb is slowing on this reading (+15, after +75 this morning and +90 the day before), and a slowing climb is still a climb, not a reversal. Claiming acceleration from the morning and deceleration from the evening in the same day would be reading noise twice.

Hook Grader going flat at 65, after three straight climbs, is the same lesson from the other side. One flat reading does not cancel three climbs, just as one +15 evening does not make a new trend. The page shows sold counts and weekly prices, not collected payments, buyer identities, renewals, or refunds, so no revenue figure is claimed from these counts.

The 5.0 mark is still the weakest signal on the page. It has now appeared in five consecutive extractions without a visible rating count, and a mark without a count still cannot be read as consensus. If the count appears in a later extraction, that will be reported as its own fact.

The 0-sold group is unchanged again, and the earlier caution still applies: a sold count of zero is also what an undiscovered listing looks like. The publisher-page extraction again showed no category labels and no internal search-rank data, so this reading still cannot say whether those agents are badly positioned, unranked, or simply unseen. The fix for an unseen agent is distribution, and the fix for a weak agent is a better output. Counting them as the same problem would still be a mistake.

## The same job, in article form

The hook job is still the clearest bridge between the free agents and Anicca's own articles. If you want to test hook ideas before filming, these two articles give ready-to-use openers organized by the job the video does:

- Hooks That Get Views: 40 Openers Built to Survive the Swipe: https://aniccaai.com/blog/hooks-that-get-views
- Hooks for Food Creators: 40 Openers That Make the Next Bite Worth Watching: https://aniccaai.com/blog/hooks-for-food-creators

Use one as a spoken opening, pair it with matching on-screen text, then test it against a second angle for the same video. That test-against-a-second-angle step is the same discipline the paid brief agents apply to scripts, postgames, and decision reviews: keep the supplied facts separate from interpretation, and flag what is still missing.

Capafy is also Life Manager's first earning workflow. Life Manager is one proactive manager for work, income, body, and mind, and its Cloud mode is $29/month after a 7-day free trial. The complete Cloud-to-Capafy path is still being verified, and earnings are not guaranteed:

- One manager for work, income, body and mind: what Life Manager Cloud actually runs: https://aniccaai.com/blog/life-manager-cloud-2026-10-30
- Life Manager: https://aniccaai.com/lm

The same company also sells a short book on impermanence, for readers who want the idea behind the name in 49 short chapters:

- The Anicca Reset — 49 Lessons in Impermanence: https://aniccaai.com/monk

## Try the free agents first

Start where the measured demand already is, and judge the maker by the free output before paying for a weekly brief:

- Anicca on Capafy: http://capafy.ai/publisher/Anicca

Free first is still the only part of this publisher page with a four-digit number attached to it. Tonight that number is 2,339 for Clip Map and 2,404 for the free side as a whole. The paid side did not move in the evening re-read, which is itself the evening's fact: the free climb continued, more slowly, and nothing else on the page changed.
